maya (support): FYI customer INC-4892 reporting streaming responses ending with an empty final chunk after token refresh + reconnect in JS/TS SDK. They see partial output then a final \"\n\n\" frame.

sam (eng-sdk): Oof. Any repro steps or logs?

maya (support): Repro steps from customer: 1) Start SSE stream with short-lived token, 2) let token expire mid-response, 3) client auto-refreshes token, reconnects, receives remaining tokens but final chunk is empty. They included a minimal repro in Node using EventSource polyfill.

maya (support): Snippet they attached:
```js
const es = new EventSource(urlWithShortToken);
es.onmessage = (e) => { process.stdout.write(e.data); };
// token refresh handler calls es.close(); then new EventSource with new token
```

alex (eng-runtime): Do they close connection before new connection is confirmed? That race could drop trailing buffer. Any server logs?

maya (support): They supplied server log excerpts:
```
[12:03:21] conn 0x7f opened, auth ok
[12:03:29] conn 0x7f token expired, client reauth requested
[12:03:29] conn 0x7f handshake failed: unexpected EOF while flushing buffer
[12:03:29] conn 0x80 opened, resuming, sent 0.87s of tokens
[12:03:29] conn 0x80 close: client-initiated
```

sam (eng-sdk): Looks like client is closing old ES before ensuring the resumed stream has consumed server-side buffered events. Our client reconnection logic currently signals close immediately when doing token swap. Could be we drop final event boundary.

ingrid (sre): Any rate/latency flags? This was reported as user-visible missing final punctuation and occasionally billing showing partial tokens.

maya (support): Yes customer saw partial outputs and billing charged for tokens sent in resumed connection but not reflected in final concatenated output. They want a reproable test we can run.

sam (eng-sdk): I'll try to reproduce locally with our EventSource test harness. Quick patch idea: when refreshing token, wait for server to emit a special \":resume_ack\" event before closing old ES. That requires server support though. Short-term we can add client-side buffering to hold last non-final chunk and wait up to 250ms for more data before emitting final newline. That avoids empty final frame flapping.

alex (eng-runtime): On the runtime side we can also change close behavior: when connection receives auth expiry we should attempt handshake transfer that guarantees last buffer flush. I'll add a small change to send a \"transfer_checkpoint\" before disconnecting. Need to coordinate with SDK change.

sam (eng-sdk): Repro notes after 30m of testing: I can reproduce in Node with token TTL=5s. Steps:
1) Start generation with long output (~2s).
2) Force token refresh at 1.5s.
3) If client closes old ES immediately and opens new, final event sometimes arrives as an empty event ("data:\n\n").
Workaround: add 200ms delay before closing old connection -> 100% reliable.

maya (support): Customer asked for ETA and a workaround they can apply now.

sam (eng-sdk): Workaround to give them: add a tiny debounce when rotating tokens, e.g.:
```js
// on token refresh
setTimeout(() => { oldEventSource.close(); openNewEventSource(); }, 200);
```
Tell them 200ms is conservative; 100ms may suffice. We're shipping a proper fix: SDK will change reconnect to buffer last non-terminal chunk and only emit an end when we see explicit end-of-stream marker or timeout. Owner: sam. PR in staging in ~2 days. Runtime change: alex will add transfer_checkpoint in 3 days.

ingrid (sre): Add an alert for unusual close rates on streaming endpoints (client-close immediately after auth refresh). That will help catch regressions.

maya (support): I'll send workaround + temporary mitigation to customer and mark INC-4892 with engineering owners. Thanks. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket INC-4892 updated: assigned to sam (eng-sdk), alex (eng-runtime). Priority: P2.

sam (eng-sdk): Follow-ups: I'll open a small E2E test that simulates token expiry mid-stream and asserts no empty final frame. Will post test results here when green.

maya (support): Please post the PR link and a short repro script we can give the customer. I will keep the ticket open until both SDK and runtime changes are deployed to staging.

alex (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll coordinate on the handshake change and post a draft patch by EOD tomorrow.

maya (support): Thanks everyone, updating INC-4892 now.
